name: zutil_zbd_open_temp_write_stream
description: zUtil_ZBD::OpenTempWriteStream returns null without an active ZBD manager and otherwise returns a CRT tmpfile stream for save callbacks.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x4c0080 reads g_zUtil_ZbdManager, returns null when it is zero, and otherwise tail-calls the CRT tmpfile thunk.
